conbody.p: At its core, DITA inherits the self-descriptive nature of XML. Each element explicitly defines the meaning of the content it contains. A <cmd/> (command) element indicates an action, while a <result/> indicates an outcome. This semantic clarity allows both humans and machines to interpret content accurately without relying on formatting cues.
